transcript.text: Who here is on their second business or
beyond?
Okay, most of you. Of the people who
raised their hands, who here's second
business grew faster than the first
business?
Almost everyone. The reason for that is
because your pattern recognition is
better. The first time you ever hired
your first salesperson, you're like, "I
don't know what these people look like."
And then you hire five of them and
finally you're like, "Ah, this one's
one." And then from that point going
forward, you're like, "Okay, this is
what a good salesperson looks like." You
have to do that across every department,
across every level. So, first you learn
what an SDR looks like, and then you
learn what a salesperson looks like, and
then you learn what a sales manager
looks like. You have to learn what each
of these are, and at every level, you
just fail a bunch of times until you get
it right and you're like, "Ah, that's
what it is."
